outfits.title: Effortless Coffee Date
outfits.explanation: This outfit leans into the 'relaxed but put together' brief. The light grey tee (#1) paired with the dark denim (#2) creates a classic, comfortable silhouette. The straight-leg denim provides a structured base, while the tee keeps it casual. The sneakers (#3) complete the look, offering both comfort and a touch of polish. The color palette is soft and muted, perfect for a coffee date.
outfits.stylingTip: Roll up the sleeves of the tee for a more relaxed feel and to show off the denim.
